examples.en: Her extravagant style made the dress perfect for a fashion show.
examples.zh: 她奢华的风格使这条裙子非常适合时装秀。

examples.en: A perfect sense of style does not require extravagant spending on fashion.
examples.zh: 出色的时尚品味并不需要在服饰上奢侈消费。

examples.en: The fashion editor found a perfect example of extravagant style in the designer’s new collection.
examples.zh: 时尚编辑在设计师的新系列中找到了奢华风格的完美范例。

examples.en: The current trend reflects a tendency towards comfort and the growing popularity of loose clothing.
examples.zh: 当前趋势反映了追求舒适的倾向，以及宽松服装日益流行。

examples.en: The popularity of second-hand shops supports the current trend and a tendency to buy less.
examples.zh: 二手店的流行推动了当下潮流，以及减少购买的倾向。

examples.en: Designers study the current trend, the popularity of new fabrics and consumers’ tendency to follow celebrities.
examples.zh: 设计师研究当前趋势、新面料的流行程度以及消费者追随名人的倾向。

examples.en: The model became a style icon and teenage idol, helping bold colours come into vogue and prevail for several seasons.
examples.zh: 这位模特成为风格偶像和青少年偶像，推动大胆色彩流行并持续盛行了好几季。

examples.en: A fashion icon or pop idol may set a vogue, but a practical model of dress is more likely to prevail.
examples.zh: 时尚偶像或流行偶像可能引领潮流，但实用的着装模式更可能长久盛行。

examples.en: The model hopes simple clothes will prevail, even though her fans treat her as an icon and idol of whatever is in vogue.
examples.zh: 这位模特希望简单衣着能盛行，尽管粉丝把她当成流行潮流的风格偶像和崇拜对象。

examples.en: The luxury jewellery shop displays a jade pendant beside a rare gem and a jewel-encrusted ring.
examples.zh: 奢华珠宝店在玉吊坠旁陈列一颗稀有宝石和一枚镶满宝石的戒指。

examples.en: A jade jewel can be the centrepiece of luxury jewellery even when it is less costly than another gem.
examples.zh: 即使玉石比另一种宝石便宜，它仍可以成为奢华首饰的核心。

examples.en: The jeweller chose a jade gem as the main jewel in a new luxury jewellery collection.
examples.zh: 珠宝商选择一颗玉石作为新奢华首饰系列的主宝石。

examples.en: They will embroider flowers to adorn the dress, then embellish the collar with a small ornament.
examples.zh: 他们会绣花装饰裙子，再用小饰件装点衣领。

examples.en: Use thread to embroider the border, beads to embellish the sleeves and one ornament to adorn the belt.
examples.zh: 用线绣边、用珠子装饰袖子，再用一件饰物点缀腰带。

examples.en: Rather than add a heavy ornament, the designer will embroider a light pattern to embellish and adorn the fabric.
examples.zh: 设计师将绣一个轻巧图案装饰布料，而不是加上沉重饰件。

examples.en: The hairdressing salon uses a dye containing a plant-based pigment.
examples.zh: 美发沙龙使用含植物色素的染发剂。

examples.en: Her hairdressing course explained how dye deposits pigment on hair.
examples.zh: 她的美发课程解释了染发剂如何把色素附着在头发上。

examples.en: The hairdressing apprentice tested the dye to see how strongly its pigment would colour a sample.
examples.zh: 美发学徒测试染发剂，观察其色素对样品的着色程度。

examples.en: She wore a silver costume and a lace veil to the masquerade.
examples.zh: 她穿银色服装、戴蕾丝面纱参加化装舞会。

examples.en: The costume for the masquerade included a long veil and a painted mask.
examples.zh: 化装舞会服装包括一条长面纱和一个彩绘面具。

examples.en: At the masquerade, nobody recognised the guest hidden beneath the costume and veil.
examples.zh: 舞会上，没有人认出藏在服装和面纱下的那位客人。

examples.en: Exquisite embroidery can fascinate visitors even when displayed on a simple, decent dress.
examples.zh: 即使展示在简单得体的裙子上，精致刺绣也能吸引访客。

examples.en: The exhibition will fascinate anyone interested in how decent everyday clothes can contain exquisite details.
examples.zh: 这次展览会吸引所有对得体日常服装中的精致细节感兴趣的人。

examples.en: A decent photograph may record the exquisite stitching, but seeing the gown in person can fascinate even experienced designers.
examples.zh: 一张不错的照片可以记录精致针脚，但亲眼看见礼服甚至能吸引经验丰富的设计师。

examples.en: She walked with grace and wore the simple gown with effortless elegance.
examples.zh: 她步态优美，穿着简单礼服，显得从容典雅。

examples.en: The collection combines the grace of flowing fabric with the elegance of clean lines.
examples.zh: 这个系列融合了流动面料的优美与简洁线条的典雅。

examples.en: The dancer’s grace gave the plain costume an unexpected elegance.
examples.zh: 舞者优美的举止使素戏服呈现出意想不到的典雅。

examples.en: Cosmetics can change your appearance, but heavy make-up is not necessary for every occasion.
examples.zh: 化妆品能改变外貌，但并非每个场合都需要浓妆。

examples.en: The cosmetics company showed how light make-up could enhance a natural appearance.
examples.zh: 化妆品公司展示了淡妆如何提升自然外貌。

examples.en: Her appearance changed after the stylist removed the stage make-up and put away the cosmetics.
examples.zh: 造型师卸掉舞台妆并收起化妆品后，她的外貌发生了变化。

examples.en: The handsome actor gave a charming smile in a beautiful garden beside a pretty cottage and an ugly shed.
examples.zh: 英俊演员在美丽花园里露出迷人笑容，旁边是一间漂亮小屋和一座难看的棚屋。

examples.en: A pretty costume and charming manner helped the handsome performer create a beautiful scene in an ugly room.
examples.zh: 漂亮戏服和迷人举止帮助英俊表演者在难看房间里营造出美丽场景。

examples.en: The photographer chose a beautiful backdrop for the handsome model, hiding an ugly wall behind a pretty screen with a charming floral design.
examples.zh: 摄影师为英俊模特选了美丽背景，用一块带迷人花卉图案的漂亮屏风遮住难看的墙。

examples.en: The charity helps clothe children with a school uniform, a warm garment and a dress for special occasions.
examples.zh: 慈善机构为儿童提供校服、保暖衣物和特殊场合穿的连衣裙。

examples.en: To clothe the cast, we need one uniform, a period dress and a plain garment for each extra.
examples.zh: 给演员配衣时，我们需要一套制服、一条年代连衣裙，以及每位群演一件素色衣服。

examples.en: The fund will clothe students who cannot afford a uniform or another suitable garment, including a simple dress.
examples.zh: 基金将为买不起制服或其他合适衣物的学生提供衣物，其中包括简单连衣裙。

examples.en: Put the clean overall in the wardrobe and send the overcoat to the laundry.
examples.zh: 把干净罩衣放进衣柜，把大衣送去洗衣店。

examples.en: His wardrobe contained a work overall and an overcoat, both fresh from the laundry.
examples.zh: 他的衣柜里有一件工作罩衣和一件大衣，都是刚洗好的。

examples.en: Before doing the laundry, she removed a stained overall from the wardrobe and checked the overcoat’s care label.
examples.zh: 洗衣前，她从衣柜拿出有污渍的罩衣，并查看大衣的护理标签。

examples.en: The costume rail held a monk’s robe, an evening gown and a hooded cloak.
examples.zh: 戏服架上有僧袍、晚礼服和连帽斗篷。

examples.en: She wore a robe over her gown backstage and added a cloak for the outdoor scene.
examples.zh: 她在后台把长袍罩在礼服外，演室外场景时又加了斗篷。

examples.en: The museum displayed a ceremonial robe beside a silk gown and a winter cloak.
examples.zh: 博物馆在一件丝绸礼服和冬季斗篷旁展出了一件礼仪长袍。

examples.en: The shop pairs a sweater and jacket with a skirt, jeans or tailored trousers.
examples.zh: 商店把毛衣和夹克搭配裙子、牛仔裤或剪裁合身的长裤。

examples.en: Pack a sweater, a jacket and jeans, plus a skirt or smart trousers for dinner.
examples.zh: 带上毛衣、夹克和牛仔裤，再带条裙子或整洁长裤用于晚餐。

examples.en: She tried the jacket over a sweater, comparing how it looked with jeans, trousers and a skirt.
examples.zh: 她把夹克套在毛衣外，比较它与牛仔裤、长裤及裙子的搭配效果。

examples.en: He wore a cotton vest beneath his shirt to keep warm.
examples.zh: 他在衬衫下穿棉汗衫保暖。

examples.en: The runner chose a lightweight vest for the summer race.
examples.zh: 跑者为夏季比赛选择了轻薄背心。

examples.en: In American English, a suit vest is the garment British speakers usually call a waistcoat.
examples.zh: 美式英语中的西装背心 vest 通常对应英式英语的 waistcoat。

examples.en: Fasten the clasp on the chain, close the top button and wrap the scarf loosely.
examples.zh: 扣好链子的搭扣，扣上最上面的纽扣，再松松围好围巾。

examples.en: The chain caught on a button as she tried to wrap the shawl around her shoulders and close its clasp.
examples.zh: 她把披肩裹上肩并扣好搭扣时，链子勾住了纽扣。

examples.en: Check the clasp and chain before you button the coat and wrap yourself in a scarf.
examples.zh: 扣大衣纽扣、围围巾前，先检查搭扣和链子。

examples.en: She tucked one glove into her hat and chose a cap with a narrow brim.
examples.zh: 她把一只手套塞进帽子，选了顶窄檐鸭舌帽。

examples.en: The broad brim of the hat offered more shade than the cap, while a glove protected her hand.
examples.zh: 这顶帽子的宽檐比鸭舌帽遮阴更多，一只手套则保护着她的手。

examples.en: A glove lay beside a cap on the brim of a large straw hat.
examples.zh: 一顶大草帽的帽檐上，手套与鸭舌帽并排放着。

examples.en: She packed a scarf and handkerchief in her bag, with coins in a purse and cards in a wallet.
examples.zh: 她把围巾和手帕装进包里，硬币放零钱包，卡放皮夹。

examples.en: The lost-property box contained a scarf, a handkerchief, a purse and a wallet.
examples.zh: 失物招领箱里有围巾、手帕、零钱包和钱包。

examples.en: Wrap the purse and wallet in the scarf, but keep the handkerchief in your pocket.
examples.zh: 用围巾包好零钱包和钱包，但把手帕放在口袋里。

examples.en: The shirt has a stiff collar and a button on each sleeve.
examples.zh: 衬衫有硬挺衣领，每只袖子上都有一颗纽扣。

examples.en: A stain on the collar matched the mark on the left sleeve.
examples.zh: 衣领上的污渍与左袖上的痕迹相同。

examples.en: The tailor shortened the sleeve and adjusted the collar.
examples.zh: 裁缝改短了袖子，调整了衣领。

examples.en: A sock and a stocking lay beside a slipper, a boot and a loose lace.
examples.zh: 短袜和长筒袜放在一只拖鞋、一只靴子和一根散鞋带旁。

examples.en: She put a sock inside the boot, folded a stocking over the slipper and tied the spare lace.
examples.zh: 她把短袜塞进靴子，把长筒袜叠在拖鞋上，再系好备用鞋带。

examples.en: The costume box contained a striped sock, a silk stocking, a soft slipper and a boot with a broken lace.
examples.zh: 戏服箱里有条纹短袜、丝袜、软拖鞋和一只鞋带断了的靴子。

examples.en: The tailor can spin wool into thread, thread a needle and sew with a neat stitch.
examples.zh: 裁缝能把羊毛纺成线、穿针，并缝出整齐针脚。

examples.en: Before you sew, ask the tailor which needle and stitch to use with the yarn you spin.
examples.zh: 缝制前，问裁缝用你纺的线该配什么针和针法。

examples.en: The workshop taught us to spin yarn and use a needle to sew a stitch under the tailor’s guidance.
examples.zh: 工作坊教我们纺线，并在裁缝指导下用针缝针脚。

examples.en: Use a pin to hold the strap, sew it with strong thread and remove the temporary string.
examples.zh: 用别针固定肩带，用结实线缝牢，再拆掉临时细绳。

examples.en: The repair kit contains a pin, thread and string for fixing a loose strap.
examples.zh: 修理包里有别针、线和细绳，用来修松动带子。

examples.en: She replaced the string around the strap with thread and secured the end with a pin.
examples.zh: 她用缝线替换带子上的细绳，并用别针固定线头。

examples.en: A ribbon with a silver stripe replaced the plain belt.
examples.zh: 一条带银色条纹的丝带替代了素腰带。

examples.en: The belt has a red stripe that matches the ribbon on the hat.
examples.zh: 腰带上有一条红纹，与帽上的丝带相配。

examples.en: She stitched a ribbon along each stripe and added a contrasting belt.
examples.zh: 她沿每道条纹缝丝带，再配上一条撞色腰带。

examples.en: The bracelet and necklace each contain a blue glass bead.
examples.zh: 手镯和项链上各有一颗蓝玻璃珠。

examples.en: A bead fell from the necklace as she reached for her bracelet.
examples.zh: 她伸手拿手镯时，一颗珠子从项链上掉下来。

examples.en: The craft kit has enough bead supplies to make a necklace and a bracelet.
examples.zh: 手工套装里的珠子材料足够做一条项链和一只手链。

examples.en: The textile exhibition compares velvet made from silk with cloth woven from wool.
examples.zh: 纺织品展览比较了丝制天鹅绒与羊毛织物。

examples.en: The textile mill produces wool fabric and a cotton velvet.
examples.zh: 这家纺织厂生产羊毛布料和棉天鹅绒。

examples.en: Students of textile design examined the surface of velvet and the warmth of wool.
examples.zh: 纺织设计专业学生考察了天鹅绒的表面和羊毛的保暖性。

examples.en: The shabby jacket was too tight, so she cut a patch from it and used the rest as a rag.
examples.zh: 这件破旧夹克太紧，她就从上面剪出一块补丁，其余当抹布。

examples.en: A tight stitch held the patch on the shabby coat, while a spare rag covered the workbench.
examples.zh: 紧密针脚把补丁固定在破旧外套上，另一块破布盖着工作台。

examples.en: Rather than turn the shabby trousers into a rag, he added a patch and loosened the tight waistband.
examples.zh: 他没有把破旧裤子改成抹布，而是补上补丁、放松了紧腰头。

examples.en: The colour chart shows white and grey neutrals beside yellow and brown.
examples.zh: 色卡把白色、灰色中性色放在黄色和棕色旁。

examples.en: A white shirt, yellow scarf and brown belt add colour to grey trousers.
examples.zh: 白衬衫、黄围巾和棕腰带给灰裤子增添色彩。

examples.en: Choose grey or white as the main colour, then add yellow stitching and brown buttons.
examples.zh: 选灰或白作主色，再加黄色缝线和棕色纽扣。

examples.en: The pink and purple fabrics may fade faster than the tan leather.
examples.zh: 粉色和紫色布料可能比棕黄色皮革褪色更快。

examples.en: Keep the pink dress, purple scarf and tan bag away from strong sunlight so they do not fade.
examples.zh: 把粉裙、紫围巾和棕黄色包远离强光，以免褪色。

examples.en: After years in the window, the pink, purple and tan samples began to fade.
examples.zh: 放在窗边多年后，粉色、紫色和棕黄色样品开始褪色。

examples.en: Blot the ink carefully before it can stain the fabric.
examples.zh: 墨水染污布料前，先小心吸干。

examples.en: A dark blot on the sleeve became a permanent stain.
examples.zh: 袖子上的一块深色污点变成了永久污渍。

examples.en: Do not rub the stain; blot it gently with a clean cloth.
examples.zh: 不要揉搓污渍；用干净布轻轻吸干。

examples.en: The model had a slender figure and a slight build.
examples.zh: 模特身材苗条、体格纤细。

examples.en: The jacket was tailored for a slender figure, with only slight adjustments at the waist.
examples.zh: 这件夹克为苗条身材裁制，只在腰部略作调整。

examples.en: Her slight figure looked slender in the long, straight dress.
examples.zh: 她纤细的身材穿上修长直裙显得苗条。
